start.name: Start
start.description: Starts a route's countdown. A route that is already running starts over.

time.name: Arrive by
time.description: Car routes only: when you want to arrive. A time that has already passed today means tomorrow.

date.name: Date
date.description: Car routes only: the day you want to arrive. Leave it out for today.

speaker.name: Speaker
speaker.description: Announce on this speaker for this run only. Leave it out for the route's speaker, or the default one in Settings.

check.name: Check drive time
check.description: Gets a car route's drive time and traffic delay right now. It's said on the speaker when announcements go to the speaker, and returned as a response for automations.
